visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man dressed in a pink halter top, white skirt, and a long wig stands on an outdoor sidewalk, looking exhausted with a pouting expression while holding a white handbag. (2) Suddenly, he is shown jumping excitedly, holding several shopping bags from various brands like Jo Malone and Hermes, with bright colorful graphic overlays around him. (3) He transitions back to a miserable state, struggling to carry many heavy shopping bags while looking at the camera with an annoyed glare. (4) He walks away from the camera in his white skirt and high-heeled sandals, swaying his hips in an exaggerated feminine manner on the paved city walkway. (5) On a concrete park bench, he sits with his wig removed, revealing short hair, wiping sweat and fanning himself in a state of physical fatigue. (6) Wearing the wig again, he walks through a commercial area, gesturing dismissively as he talks to the camera, appearing to complain about a recent experience. (7) He spots a white fluffy Bichon Frise dog and rushes over, smiling broadly and petting the animal held by a woman in a black shirt. (8) He stoops down to touch his foot in a high-heeled sandal, grimacing in pain, then looks around urgently as if searching for something. (9) He holds up a light blue ChargeSpot power bank, speaking rapidly and with high energy while standing in a park-like setting with sunlight filtering through trees. (10) He gestures toward the power bank's built-in charging cable and then returns to the scene with the dog, holding the device and smiling brightly for the camera with the woman and the pet.
